crossRefs.note: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
“You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you…
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

translations.web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
translations.bsb: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
translations.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
translations.asv: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul. Psalm 110 A Psalm of David.
